title: How much say do parents have in setting therapy goals for their child?
metaTitle: Role of Parents in Setting Therapy Goals - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about how Pinnacle Blooms Network values the important role of parents in setting therapy goals for their children undergoing Occupational Therapy.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we deeply value the role of parents in therapy. We believe you know your child best. Our therapists form a collaborative team with you, acknowledging your observations and inputs about your child's needs. Together, we define and refine therapy goals that best serve your child's requirements.
